=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:389-390 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: substitution_bodies() does not inherit the outer double-quote state when entering $(...) substitutions.
  WHY: When entering a $(...) substitution from an already double-quoted context, inner_double is initialized to False, which can cause the inner scanner to incorrectly parse double quotes inside the substitution body as new quoting boundaries and miss a hidden gh api call.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:591, 597 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Test cases for balanced nested parentheses within double-quoted strings inside $(...) or quoted parentheses within $(...) remain ambiguous or possibly incorrect.
  WHY: The scanner's inability to inherit double-quote state, combined with incomplete test coverage for mixed quoting inside $(...), leaves the guard vulnerable to incorrect extraction of substitution bodies.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
